source.title: Parts Express product page: cutout 1.69 in, outside 2.04 in, depth 0.98 in, 4 mounting holes, bolt circle 1.9 (no unit printed; read as inches like the page's other sizes)

note: A balanced-mode radiator: a flat diaphragm that moves as a piston low down and bends above. The lab models it as a piston, so its wide high-frequency dispersion is not represented. Linear travel 2.5 mm is from the Parts Express page; the maker's sheet prints only an 8 mm peak-to-peak mechanical limit. Sheet revision 1.0 printed fs 145 Hz, Vas 0.18 L, Qes 1.06, Qms 3.84; revision 1.8 is used.
